parts: who.group_mix vs actual held voters (group and subgroup)
CF-only and raw voter lists at N-hat
why: Scoring needs listed people (the frozen ~2,260-person CF list) who were held before the day and re-read after its close. None of the listed people has been re-read after the close of Nov 13, Nov 14 or Nov 15.
reading: Reads since Nov 14 are almost all first reads of new people, not re-reads of held ones. The last day with re-read listed people is Nov 12.
needed: Re-read the listed people after each day's close (ids in tmp/e5/private/backer_arms/<day>.parquet, arm CF-only), or a full held re-read.
